text: {"findings":[{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"No generative AI / personal data review recorded","detail":"The proposal deploys a GenAI LLM chatbot that identifies customers by phone number and accesses order history (personal data). No privacy, legal, or AI governance review is recorded; only vendor selection is mentioned.","evidence_quote":"Vendor selection is in progress.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Obtain and record GenAI policy, privacy/data protection, and security reviews (including vendor data-handling terms) before launch."},{"type":"UNDEFINED_METRIC","title":"Success metric 'Customer happiness' is not a canonical metric","detail":"'Customer happiness' is vague and does not correspond to a defined glossary metric (e.g., CSAT). It is also unclear how it is measured and how it relates to the stated deflection goal.","evidence_quote":"Customer happiness: from 4.0 to 4.4 within 12 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Replace with a canonical metric (e.g., contact CSAT or Contact Rate/deflection rate) with a clear definition and measurement method."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced 60% deflection claim","detail":"The 60% deflection expectation is stated without any source, pilot data, or benchmark.","evidence_quote":"We expect the chatbot to deflect 60% of contacts.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite supporting evidence (vendor benchmark, pilot, historical analysis) or reframe as a hypothesis with a justified range."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days is not the issue but 3 weeks vs 12-week target mismatch; MDE misaligned with success metric","detail":"The success metric targets a 12-week outcome but the experiment runs only 3 weeks, so it cannot validate the success metric. The MDE is stated for contacts per 100, not for the primary success metric, and the deflection claim is not tested.","evidence_quote":"Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 0.5 contacts per 100, power 80%.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Align duration, primary metric, and MDE/power calculation with the success metric (or change the success timeframe), and include deflection as a measured outcome."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Missing guardrails for GenAI answer quality and data safety","detail":"A customer-facing LLM giving order information needs guardrails such as answer accuracy/hallucination rate, escalation-to-human rate, and privacy incidents or misidentification. Only Contact Rate and Delivery CSAT are listed.","evidence_quote":"- Contact Rate: stop if it rises by more than 1 per 100.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails for incorrect-answer rate, human escalation/failed-resolution rate, and privacy/misidentification incidents, with stop thresholds."}]}
